extra.message: PATCH /api/notifications/preferences assigns the entire request body to the authenticated User entity. A borrower can submit {"role":"admin"} to become an administrator. Protected fields including passwordHash, email, and id are also writable.

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

cwe: CWE-89: SQL Injection

extra.message: evaluateCovenantExpression constructs and invokes a Function containing an unrestricted expression supplied to POST /api/applications/:id/covenant-test. cwe: CWE-95: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code

extra.message: POST /api/documents/:docId/repackage inserts body.targetFormat into a command executed through a shell. A borrower with access to an uploaded document can supply shell substitutions or metacharacters to execute arbitrary operating-system commands.

cwe: CWE-78: OS Command Injection

extra.message: GET /api/data/reports/portfolio/render incorporates the outputType query parameter into a shell command without validation or escaping. An underwriter or administrator can execute arbitrary commands through this parameter.

cwe: CWE-78: OS Command Injection

extra.message: restoreViewPreferences reads arbitrary local paths from SYSTEM entity declarations and substitutes their contents into returned fields. cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: POST /api/documents/:docId/upload-with-correction assigns unvalidated correction JSON to the Document entity after checking ownership. cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: POST /api/borrowers/:id/intake-draft/:draft decodes attacker-controlled base64 JSON and assigns every field to a BorrowerProfile after authorization. cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: POST /api/dashboard/workspace-preferences passes arbitrary JSON through registerQueuePreferences into mergeDeep. cwe: CWE-1321: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes

extra.message: GET /api/products/:id/agreement-template joins the variant query parameter into a filesystem path without containment validation. cwe: CWE-22: Path Traversal

extra.message: GET /api/products/industry-guidance uses the borrower's stored industry directly in a filesystem path. Borrowers can save ../ segments through the profile update endpoint and then read accessible .txt files outside the industry-guidance directory.

cwe: CWE-22: Path Traversal

extra.message: POST /api/dashboard/desk-layout uses the attacker-controlled deskId cookie as a relative path and writes the request body there. Any authenticated user can traverse outside workspaceCacheDir and create or overwrite writable .json files, including application configuration files.

cwe: CWE-22: Path Traversal

extra.message: GET /api/dashboard/desk-layout reads a path constructed from the deskId cookie without containment checks. Any authenticated user can use ../ segments to retrieve readable JSON files outside workspaceCacheDir. The target must have a .json suffix and contain valid JSON.

cwe: CWE-22: Path Traversal

extra.message: Document replacement deletes path.join(uploadDir, doc.storedName) without constraining the stored path. A borrower can first set storedName to a traversal path using upload-with-correction, then upload again to delete a server-writable file outside uploadDir. The correction and import handlers repeat this unsafe deletion pattern.

cwe: CWE-22: Path Traversal

extra.message: Logo replacement deletes a path derived from profile.logoAssetName without containment validation. A borrower can set logoAssetName to a traversal path through intake-draft restoration and then upload a logo to delete a writable file outside privateAssetsDir.

cwe: CWE-22: Path Traversal

extra.message: POST /api/documents/:docId/import-from-source fetches a borrower-supplied URL without restricting destinations. cwe: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery

extra.message: The unauthenticated POST /api/embed/application/:id/handoff uses jwt.decode instead of signature verification and only requires a truthy sub claim. cwe: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

extra.message: GET /api/data/reports/branch-cost-allocation falls back to jwt.decode whenever verification fails. An unauthenticated attacker can supply an unsigned, expired, or incorrectly signed token containing branchId and receive portfolio application counts and total requested amounts.

cwe: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

extra.message: GET /api/data/reports/branch-cost-allocation-export accepts any HS256 token signed with the normal session secret, without requiring a branch claim, privileged role, or report-specific audience. cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: POST /api/servicing/application/:id/handoff verifies a token signature but never authorizes its subject against the requested application. cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: GET /api/servicing/application/:id/payoff-quote is registered without authentication or partner credentials. Anyone knowing an application UUID can retrieve its principal and daily accrual, exposing private loan information.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: GET /api/borrowers/payment-accounts/:acctId loads and returns a PaymentAccount without checking its owning profile. Any authenticated borrower knowing another account UUID can obtain its bank name, account type, masked account and routing numbers, and borrowerProfileId.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: GET /api/shares/application/:appId/view trusts query.dataLevel instead of bounding it by share.dataLevel. An accepted summary-only recipient can request dataLevel=full to obtain financialSummary, taxId, annualRevenue, owner information, and contact details that were not granted.

cwe: CWE-863: Incorrect Authorization

extra.message: GET /api/data/export/applications has neither the admin/underwriter role gate used by adjacent exports nor borrower ownership filtering. cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: PATCH /api/servicing/application/:id/repayment-plan checks only whether the caller is an underwriter or administrator. cwe: CWE-863: Incorrect Authorization

extra.message: POST /api/applications/:id/assign lets any underwriter replace an existing assignment with their own ID or null. It never checks the current assignedUnderwriterId. cwe: CWE-863: Incorrect Authorization

extra.message: POST /api/borrowers/:id/intake-draft-validated/:draft permits underwriters to update borrower profiles. loadProfileForAccess grants staff read access, but this handler never applies the explicit underwriter write prohibition used by PATCH /api/borrowers/:id. cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: POST /api/applications/:id/counter/accept unconditionally sets status to approved whenever any historical counteroffer exists. cwe: CWE-841: Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow

extra.message: Every approved decision invokes routeApprovedDisbursement. assertTransition permits a transition to the current status, so repeating POST /api/applications/:id/decision with outcome=approved on an approved loan generates additional payout requests. cwe: CWE-841: Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow

extra.message: The decision endpoint saves a Decision before validating the application status transition and uses no transaction. An authorized underwriter can submit an invalid transition, such as rejecting an approved loan, and still persist that decision despite the error response. The false decision then appears in borrower history and exports.

cwe: CWE-841: Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow

extra.message: JWT signing and verification fall back to a publicly known hardcoded secret whenever JWT_SECRET is absent, including in production. An attacker can forge valid session tokens for existing users and authenticate as those users.

cwe: CWE-321: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key

extra.message: signBranchTerminalToken signs staff session JWTs without an expiration. cwe: CWE-613: Insufficient Session Expiration

extra.message: Password reset changes passwordHash and consumes the reset token but does not invalidate existing session JWTs. requireAuth checks only token validity and account activity, with no password-change timestamp or session version. cwe: CWE-613: Insufficient Session Expiration

extra.message: POST /api/auth/login directly invokes password verification without rate limiting, failed-attempt tracking, or lockout. cwe: CWE-307: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts

cwe: CWE-807: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision

extra.message: Each distinct client-supplied X-Forwarded-For value creates a persistent entry in the module-level buckets Map. Entries are never deleted after expiration. cwe: CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

cwe: CWE-321: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: Partner signup stores passwords using one unsalted SHA-256 operation. This permits fast offline dictionary attacks on exposed password hashes and produces identical hashes for accounts sharing a password, unlike the bcrypt-based portal authentication service.

cwe: CWE-312: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information

cwe: CWE-201: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information
